message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/coturn && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
p.write_text('[{"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/FuzzStun.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"Data/Size","code":"stun_is_command_message_full_check_str((uint8_t *)Data, Size, 1, NULL);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are passed as a STUN message candidate into the parser and integrity checker."},{"step":2,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_is_command_message_full_check_str","line":476,"var":"buf/blen","code":"if (!stun_is_command_message_str(buf, blen)) return 0;","note":"The input must first satisfy the STUN command-message shape before deeper attribute parsing occurs."},{"step":3,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_attr_get_first_by_type_str","line":1384,"var":"buf/len/attr_type","code":"stun_attr_ref attr = stun_attr_get_first_str(buf, len);","note":"The parser walks the attacker-controlled attribute list to locate the FINGERPRINT attribute."},{"step":4,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_attr_get_first_str","line":1410,"var":"buf/len","code":"stun_attr_ref attr = (stun_attr_ref)(buf + STUN_HEADER_LENGTH);","note":"Attribute iteration begins immediately after the fixed STUN header, so malformed length fields can influence subsequent reads."},{"step":5,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_check_message_integrity_str","line":1965,"var":"upwd/pwd","code":"len = strncpy((char *)pwd, (const char *)upwd, sizeof(password_t) - 1);","note":"The short-term credential path copies the constant password into a fixed-size stack buffer before HMAC verification."},{"step":6,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_check_message_integrity_by_key_str","line":1919,"var":"sarlen/shasize","code":"switch (sarlen) { case SHA1SIZEBYTES: shasize = SHA1SIZEBYTES; ... }","note":"The integrity checker derives the expected HMAC size from the parsed MESSAGE-INTEGRITY attribute length."},{"step":7,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_check_message_integrity_by_key_str","line":1940,"var":"new_len","code":"int new_len = (int)((const uint8_t *)sar - buf) + 4 + shasize;","note":"The code recomputes the message length from the attribute pointer and HMAC size, creating a trust boundary on parsed offsets."},{"step":8,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_check_message_integrity_by_key_str","line":1947,"var":"new_hmac","code":"stun_calculate_hmac(buf, (size_t)new_len - 4 - shasize, pwd, strlen((char *)pwd), new_hmac, &shasize, shatype);","note":"The recalculated HMAC is computed over attacker-controlled message bytes using the copied password, and any parser miscalculation here can drive an out-of-bounds memory-safety sink."}]')
print(p.read_text())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
